title: Laundry Sorter
shareTitle: Laundry Sorter — Sort, Fold, and Match
description: Sort colorful socks, fold soft towels with broad swipes, and find matching pairs in a cheerful storybook laundry room for ages 5–6.
learningGoals: Follow a two-step folding sequence with broad directional swipes
Build helping-at-home pride through a short laundry routine
interactionModel: strand-proof drag plus tap-tap sorting, broad swipe or tap folding, and face-up pair matching
feedbackModel: Correct chores use soft fabric motion, sparkles, bubbles, basket counts, and warm recorded praise; misses wobble gently and replay a spoken model.
